people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Kanah
people.line: Town in Asher's territory; village where Jesus performed miracles

translations.web: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
translations.bsb: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
translations.kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
translations.asv: This beginning of his signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
